title: jaxmore
details: The utilities you keep re-writing, collected in one place.

highlight.alt: The jaxmore logo: JAX's, its letters built from coloured rhombi, with the J's stem crossed by a dark-grey bar of the same rhombi into a big plus.
highlight.description: There's more to JAX: the utilities you keep re-writing, such as a vmap with static arguments, a reverse-mode-friendly bounded while loop, and scan-based training loops.
